title: Observed enterprise exposure in real worklogs clusters in a narrow fraction of theoretical benchmark capability
text: Analysis of production telemetry demonstrates that actual user tasks involve only a small, conservative subset of what frontier benchmarks suggest models can accomplish. Theoretical task susceptibility does not translate directly into operational deployment due to unaddressed integration, liability, and verification hurdles.
qualification: Empirical telemetry analysis of real Claude worklogs; reflects self-selected user requests rather than an experimental randomized control trial of enterprise workflows.

public_locator.value: Observed exposure in real work logs is a small fraction of theoretical task vulnerability.
